southAfricaGepfOfficialSourceRecheck.benefitsContract: The official GEPF retirement-benefits and employer-contributions pages remain reachable; the published benefit structure, contribution boundaries and Fund decision boundary remain the maintained engine source contract.
southAfricaGepfOfficialSourceRecheck.actuarialContract: GEPF published revised actuarial-interest factors effective 1 October 2025. The shared engine keeps its reviewed factor contract and identifies the estimate as planning-only rather than a Fund quote.
southAfricaGepfOfficialSourceRecheck.decision: No formula parameter changed. The Swahili route delegates to the maintained za-gepf engine and does not determine recognised service, tax, withdrawal eligibility or final Fund benefits.

southAfricaTransferDutyOfficialSourceRec.rateContract: Official SARS Budget 2026 guidance and Act 3 of 2026 retain the 2027 transfer-duty table effective 1 April 2026.
southAfricaTransferDutyOfficialSourceRec.valueContract: The SARS eFiling guide retains the greater-of-fair-value-and-consideration assessment boundary and the treatment of other consideration.
southAfricaTransferDutyOfficialSourceRec.decision: No bracket or formula changed. Only the engine verified-through date advanced to the source-review date; VAT status remains explicit user input and VAT itself is not calculated.

southAfricaUifOfficialSourceRecheck.contributionContract: SARS still publishes the 1% employee plus 1% employer contribution and the R17,712 monthly ceiling.
southAfricaUifOfficialSourceRecheck.ordinaryBenefitContract: The Department fact sheet and Easy Aid guide retain the daily-income formula, 38%-60% first 238 days, 20% days 239-365 and maximum 365 verified credits.
southAfricaUifOfficialSourceRecheck.maternityContract: The official UIF maternity page retains the 66% rate, 121-day maximum and employer-pay top-up boundary.
southAfricaUifOfficialSourceRecheck.decision: No formula parameter changed. The Swahili route remains a planning tool and leaves credits, eligibility, claims and approved payment to UIF.

southAfricaDividendTaxOfficialSourceRech.ratesContract: The official SARS Dividends Tax page remains reachable and states 20% for dividends paid on or after 22 February 2017, with payment by the last day of the following month. The 2027 SARS interest-and-dividends page confirms no rate change.
southAfricaDividendTaxOfficialSourceRech.reliefContract: SARS continues to require the relevant declaration and undertaking before an exemption or reduced DTA rate may be applied; the DTA portal remains the treaty source boundary.
southAfricaDividendTaxOfficialSourceRech.decision: No formula parameter changed. The Swahili route delegates to the reviewed za-dividend-tax engine and does not infer beneficial ownership, treaty eligibility, exemption, filing, assessment or payment status.

southAfricaCgtOfficialSourceRecheck.ratesContract: The official SARS CGT page remains reachable and identifies the 2027 assessment year as 1 March 2026 through 28 February 2027; the official individual-rate page and comprehensive CGT guide remain the engine source boundary.
southAfricaCgtOfficialSourceRecheck.decision: No formula parameter changed. The Swahili route delegates to the reviewed za-cgt engine and does not decide capital-versus-revenue classification, residence eligibility, valuation, filing, assessment or payment.

nigeriaWhtOfficialSourceRecheck.regulationsContract: The official 2024 Gazette remains reachable and states the transaction, recipient, residence, Tax ID and ratified-treaty rules used by the unchanged engine.
nigeriaWhtOfficialSourceRecheck.administrationContract: Nigeria Tax Administration Act 2025 section 51 requires deduction at prescribed regulatory rates; JRB 2026 guidance continues to reference the 2024 Regulations and federal transition guidance retains the 1 January 2026 boundary.
nigeriaWhtOfficialSourceRecheck.decision: No formula parameter changed. The Swahili route delegates to the reviewed engine, requires scope and relief evidence, and makes no filing, authority, treaty-entitlement or exemption decision.

nigeriaCitOfficialSourceRecheck.actContract: The NIPC-published Nigeria Tax Act 2025 remains reachable and states the small-company definition, 0% or 30% company-tax branch, 4% development levy and section 57 review trigger used by the existing engine.
nigeriaCitOfficialSourceRecheck.transitionContract: Federal Ministry of Finance guidance published in June 2026 still states that the Nigeria Tax Act 2025 applies from 1 January 2026.
nigeriaCitOfficialSourceRecheck.decision: No formula parameter changed. The Swahili route delegates to the reviewed English engine, requires explicit scope confirmation and does not calculate the section 57 top-up or make a filing or assessment decision.

nigeriaCgtOfficialSourceRecheck.actContract: The NIPC-published Nigeria Tax Act 2025 remains reachable and states the Nigerian-share proceeds, gain and same-year reinvestment rules used by the existing engine.
nigeriaCgtOfficialSourceRecheck.transitionContract: Federal Ministry of Finance guidance published in June 2026 still states that the Nigeria Tax Act 2025 applies from 1 January 2026.
nigeriaCgtOfficialSourceRecheck.decision: No formula parameter changed. The Swahili route delegates to the reviewed English engine and remains a scoped planning estimate rather than a filing, assessment or exemption decision.

mauritaniaOfficialSourceRecheck.dgiItsContract: Official DGI obligations page remained reachable and states monthly ITS rates of 15%, 25% and 40%.
mauritaniaOfficialSourceRecheck.cnssContributionContract: Official CNSS declaration form remained reachable and states 13% employer CNSS, 1% worker CNSS and 2% occupational medicine.
mauritaniaOfficialSourceRecheck.decision: No formula or cap changed; the reviewed 2026-07-21 source contract and 2026-10-31 next-review boundary remain in force.
